name: silverbullet
title: SilverBullet
description: Markdown notes in the browser that work offline and can be extended with queries, templates and scripts. The notes are plain .md files in the App-Data folder. After deploying, sign in with the user name and password you set below.

variables.name: SILVERBULLET_USER
variables.label: User name
variables.description: The one account that can open the notes

variables.name: SILVERBULLET_PASSWORD
variables.label: Password
variables.description: Its password (no colon in it). Change it here and deploy again to change it
